name: Animoceps Rager
rulesText: Whenever this Headquarters is dealt damage, Scratch 1. This ability triggers only once each turn.

name: Colossus Platform
rulesText: Whenever this Headquarters attacks, chosen allied unit gains 1 armor.

name: Command Barge
rulesText: Discard a card, exhaust: Draw 2 cards, then discard a card.

name: Encampment
rulesText: Discard a card, exhaust: Deal 1 damage to each of up to 2 chosen non-Scratch Company units.

name: Enclave
rulesText: Discard a card, exhaust: Regroup up to 2 chosen allied units.

name: Eternal Watchman
rulesText: Whenever this Headquarters attacks and kills an opposing unit or structure, return chosen unit card from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Rift
rulesText: Discard a card, exhaust: Scratch 2. Deal 5 damage to this Headquarters.

name: Tidal Leviathan
rulesText: Whenever this Headquarters deals damage, chosen allied unit or structure heals 1.
